prompt: Dev practises coding problems daily but never checks solutions or test results, and repeats the same logical error for weeks. What is missing from his practice?

options.text: More hours of the same practice each day
A study partner to sit beside him
A feedback loop: comparing his solution with a correct one so errors are found and corrected

explanation: Practice without feedback can entrench mistakes. Checking results and studying where his reasoning diverged turns repetition into deliberate practice.
